last_evidence.facts: CLIP-032 complete: ProvenanceStore (provenance manifests/fingerprints) — append-only provenance steps (captured|transformed|enriched|published; item + org validated; audited provenance.step_appended), generate_manifest (canonical sorted-keys compact JSON, deterministic sha256 hash computed server-side and recorded, audited provenance.manifest_generated), content_fingerprints (algorithm sha256|sha1|md5 with hex length+charset validation: 64/40/32, idempotent per (manifest_id, algorithm)), org-scoped listings, steps stored as JSON column on manifests (append-only by convention + audited); migration 0013 CREATE-only (2 tables) verified on real PG (0012->0013, tables present); 5 operator routes wired; 12 new tests; land 44588bd, merge 29131f1, CI green all 4 jobs; suite 374+11, ruff format/check + mypy clean (39 files)
